verdict.rationale: Mercury has its own documented ways to get data out: account statements and invoice PDFs, plus API, CLI and MCP endpoints that list all transactions, categories, merchants, customers, invoices and treasury statements, and sync to QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite. However, nothing documents a one-shot, complete account export in open structured formats (e.g. CSV/JSON archive) or an account-closure/offboarding path, so leaving with all data relies on scripting against the API. Missing for 10: a documented bulk 'export all data' feature, explicit open-format (CSV/JSON) download coverage across all data types, offboarding/account-closure guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of complete data portability.
